battle.name: 十三翼之戰
battle.theater: 答闌巴勒主惕草原與斡難河上游
battle.brief: 金明昌四年（一八八九）鐵木真被諸部推為汗，與結拜兄弟札木合決裂；翌年札木合集三萬騎進犯，鐵木真亦集三萬分作十三翼，迎戰於答闌巴勒主惕而敗。札木合屠殺俘獲、獨吞戰利品，其部將人心離散、率眾來附，鐵木真反因此壯大。此役純為草原騎兵之戰，卡面希臘火仍屬拜占庭海軍機密，與此無涉。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 十三翼之戰並非國家與國家之間的戰爭，而是蒙古高原上兩支部族聯軍的內戰。鐵木真一方以孛兒只斤氏的家族部眾為骨幹：母親斛帖、兄弟哈撒兒與別里古台，加上早年隨行的木華黎、博爾術、者勒蔑等那可兒，靠結拜盟誓與共同牧地維繫，戰時由各小部落分別召集，再編為十數支「翼」作戰。札木合一方以札達剌氏的札木合為首，他原是泰亦赤兀氏眾望所歸的盟主，旗下聯軍由各部頭目率領，馬匹與兵員數量佔優，統屬關係卻更鬆散，靠賞賜與盟誓維繫。兩邊都沒有常備軍，沒有城牆可守，沒有國庫可以養兵，兵源就是出徵的部落丁口與牧群；盟誓一旦破裂，部眾隨時可以脫隊轉投另一方。戰場之外的金朝正處在章宗與衛紹王交替的幾年，注意力放在西南的西夏與邊地羈縻諸部，對高原各部鞭長莫及，雙方的衝突沒有任何第三方可以仲裁。
countriesEn: The Battle of the Thirteen Banners was not a war between states but a civil war between two tribal confederations on the Mongolian plateau. Temüjin's side was built around the household of the Borjigin clan: his mother Ho'elun, his brothers Qasar and Belgütei, together with such sworn followers as Muqali, Bo'orchu and Jelme, bound together by the anda oath and by common pasture. At war each small clan was summoned on its own and then reorganised into a dozen or so wings, a wing being the tactical unit. Jamuqa's side was led by Jamuqa of the Jadarada clan, who had been the acknowledged head of the Taichiud people; the confederation under him was commanded by the chiefs of the various clans, richer in horses and men but far looser in discipline, held together by bounty and oath alone. Neither side had a standing army, walls to defend or a treasury to maintain troops: the fighting force was simply the clansmen and the herds they brought with them, and once an oath broke a clan could slip away and join the other side. Outside the battlefield the Jin dynasty was in the handover from Emperor Zhangzong to the Prince of Wei, its attention fixed on Western Xia and on the tribes it kept on the leash along the frontier; it could neither arbitrate the quarrel nor had any wish to, and the two hosts settled their differences by themselves.
people: 主角是鐵木真與札木合。此時的鐵木真還沒有「成吉思汗」這個號，一二〇六年諸王才把那個稱號奉上，此前史書只稱他鐵木真。他以孛兒只斤氏族長兼家長的身份，直接能支配的只有數十名至數百名貼身那可兒與家族部眾；推舉他為汗的諸部首領，多半出於對他本事的承認，而不是出於制度上的隸屬。他的兄弟哈撒兒、別里古台是最早的核心支持者，母親斛帖在推舉時力挺哈撒兒，說他做主汗能服眾；博爾術、者勒蔑、木華黎等人先後以個人身分加入，組成第一批只認他個人的班底。札木合是泰亦赤兀氏的盟主，也是鐵木真早年的結拜兄弟，兩人曾以安答相誓；此番他集合三萬人挑戰，志在壓過對方，而不是吞併全境。札木合麾下各翼的將領才是這場戰爭真正的轉折點：他們在戰後不滿札木合獨吞戰利品與處置俘獲的做法，陸續率眾來附鐵木真，成為他這幾年最寶貴的補充兵源。
peopleEn: The principals were Temüjin and Jamuqa. At this date Temüjin did not yet hold the title of Genghis Khan, which the princes bestowed on him only in 1206; until then the chronicles call him simply Temüjin. What he could command directly was a few dozen to a few hundred sworn nökör and kinsmen of his own household, and the chiefs who acclaimed him did so out of recognition of his ability rather than from any institutional subordination. His brothers Qasar and Belgütei were his earliest supporters, and his mother Ho'elun argued for Qasar at the acclamation, saying that he could hold the tribes in line. Bo'orchu, Jelme and Muqali joined one by one and formed the first nucleus of men personally loyal to him. Jamuqa was the accepted leader of the Taichiud and had been Temüjin's sworn brother, the two of them bound by the anda oath; this time he gathered thirty thousand men not to occupy a stretch of country but to impose his command on his rival. The commanders of the wings under Jamuqa were the real hinge of the whole affair: dissatisfied with the way he kept the spoils and disposed of the prisoners, they came over to Temüjin in body, and with them the best recruits he obtained in those years.
kits: 交戰雙方是純粹的草原騎兵，裝備核心是馬與弓。蒙古弓為反曲複合弓，以角、筋、木條製成，拉力一般估算在六十至七十公斤，箭重約五百克上下，有效射程一百五十至二百公尺；箭鏃以骨或鐵製成，三棱鐵鏃在斡難河上游的蒙古人墓葬中出土數量極多。近戰用榆木或白樺木桿的鐵矛，以及帶血槽的短刀與環首刀；防具以獸皮甲為主，貴族與貼身衛士有札甲，少數首領另有鎖子甲，另有圓形皮盾用於最後的貼身格擋。馬具簡陋，木鞍架加毛氈鞍墊與皮製韁頭，並無高勒馬鐙。營具是毛氈帳幕，隨軍自攜，沒有攻城器械，也沒有投石機一類重裝備；糧秣是風乾乳酪、鹽、牛肉乾與酸馬奶，全部靠騎兵自帶。卡面上的希臘火在此完全沒有出現。希臘火本來是拜占庭海軍的裝備，靠銅管把配方不明的液態燃燒劑噴向水面，載體是船而不是馬，配套的是帝國財力與嚴格的配方保密；卡面把它列在陸戰一欄，已與它的實際用法相差萬里。蒙古高原沒有船隊，沒有銅管，也沒有液態燃料，戰場上唯一的火是營火與火把；即便拜占庭的使節與商船數度到達東方，中土自有的猛火油記載也從未把那份配方東傳。配方隨船沉沒，技術便隨之斷絕，而這場戰爭裡真正流動的祕方，是編組與忠誠。
kitsEn: Both sides fought as pure steppe cavalry, and the equipment centred on the horse and the bow. The Mongol bow was a composite recurved bow of horn, sinew and wood, with a draw weight generally estimated at sixty to seventy kilograms, arrows of about five hundred grams, and a useful range of a hundred and fifty to two hundred metres; arrowheads were made of bone or iron, and quantities of three-edged iron points have come out of Mongol burials along the upper Onon. Close fighting was done with iron spears on ash or birch shafts and with short swords with a fuller and ring-pommelled blades; protection was boiled hide, with lamellar armour for nobles and personal guards, mail for a few chiefs, and small round hide shields carried for the last moment. The harness was plain, a wooden tree with a felt pad and a leather bridle, and there were no high stirrups. The camp was felt tents carried with the column; there were no siege engines, no trebuchets and no heavy equipment, and the larder was dried cheese, salt, dried beef and fermented mare's milk, all carried by the riders themselves. The Greek fire of the card had no part in this at all. It was Byzantine naval equipment, projected from a bronze pipe as a liquid burning mixture of unknown formula, carried by ships rather than by horses and backed by imperial finance and strict secrecy about the recipe; the card files it under land warfare, which is a long way from how it was actually used. The Mongolian plateau had no fleets, no bronze pipes and no liquid fuel, and the only fire on the battlefield was the campfire and the torch. Even though Byzantine envoys and merchant ships reached the East on several occasions, the native Chinese records of naphtha never carried that formula eastward. The formula sank with the ships and the technique died with it, while what really circulated in this war was not a burning mixture but a system of organisation and loyalty.
tactics: 草原騎兵不作正面線對峙，作戰單位是「翼」，每翼數十至數百騎，臨陣散開成散兵線，互不相擾。進攻前通常以小股騎兵挑釁、偵察，並驅趕對手的牲畜群，奪走牧群不只是奪戰利品，更是摧毀對方過冬的生計。真正交手時雙方都靠箭雨覆蓋，騎手在五百步外即放箭，逐步逼近到六十步左右再作近射，一輪箭幕可覆蓋數十至百餘支。接戰之後長矛與刀的作用才顯出來，騎兵多作迂迴與平行追擊，企圖切斷對手退回營帳的路線，而不是去攻取任何城邑。這場戰役沒有壕溝、沒有木柵、沒有火攻，勝負取決於聯軍內部的協同與指揮鏈：札木合的十三翼各有其長，進退有節；鐵木真的三萬眾雖同樣號稱分作十三翼，各翼之間卻缺乏統一節拍，混戰中被各個擊破，一翼潰散便牽動全線。敗退時草原騎兵慣於斜行退卻、佯敗誘敵，但鐵木真的退卻變成了真正的崩潰，從者散盡，只餘數十騎突出重圍。札木合追擊一段便止，未作遠逼，這是草原戰爭中常見的克制：追得太遠，牧群與水源都會被拖垮。
tacticsEn: Steppe cavalry did not fight in a continuous line. The unit of manoeuvre was the wing, from several dozen to several hundred riders, deployed into loose order without interfering with its neighbours. Before the attack, small parties rode out to taunt, to scout and to drive off the enemy's herds, since taking animals was not merely prize but a way of destroying the means by which the enemy would winter. Once contact was made both sides relied on the arrow shower, riders loosing at five hundred paces and closing to about sixty paces before shooting at close range, a single volley covering anything from several dozen to more than a hundred arrows. Only then did spear and sword tell, the cavalry swinging wide and running in parallel to cut the road back to the enemy's tents rather than to take any walled place. There were no ditches, no palisades and no fire attack here; the outcome turned on the coordination and the chain of command inside each confederation. Jamuqa's thirteen wings each had its own strength and moved in step, while Temüjin's thirty thousand, though said to have been divided into thirteen wings as well, lacked a common rhythm and in the melee were beaten wing by wing, one collapse dragging the next. On the steppe, retreat was normally oblique and feigned to draw the enemy on; Temüjin's withdrawal became a real rout, the column dissolved and only a few dozen riders brought him out. Jamuqa pursued for a distance and then stopped rather than pressing far, a restraint common in steppe war, for a long chase would exhaust his own herds and his own water.
data: 可核對的數字有限，而且幾乎全部出自《蒙古秘史》一家之記。時序上，一般把鐵木真被推為汗定在一八八九年（金明昌四年），部分學者繫於一八八八年；札木合集合三萬人的進犯在翌年，即一八九〇年；答闌巴勒主惕之戰隨即爆發。原始記載只記年不記月，所以本條的月份欄以一八八九年末的約數標記，實際交戰發生在一八九〇年。兵力方面，札木合與鐵木真各約三萬人，兩家記數互異，多數學者取《蒙古秘史》此數而視之為概數。行程與距離方面，蒙古騎兵在草場上日行約二百至三百里，馬匹每日須飲水數次，因此戰鬥多集中在晨昏與水源附近。答闌巴勒主惕按蒙古語字義大意是「廣闊而有湖的草原」，其確切位置至今未經考古確認，一般置於今蒙古國東部、斡難河上游一帶。傷亡與俘獲的數目史無明文，不宜推算；可以確定的只是，戰後鐵木真一方人馬銳減，而札木合一方在不斷接收新來附者的同時，自身的聯軍結構開始由內鬆動。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, and almost all of them come from a single text, the Secret History of the Mongols. As to sequence, the acclamation of Temüjin as khan is usually placed in 1189, the fourth year of the Jin Mingchang era, though some scholars put it in 1188; Jamuqa's gathering of thirty thousand men and his invasion fall in the following year, 1190, and the battle at Dalan Baljud followed. The primary records give the year but never the month, so the month field here is set to the end of 1189 as an approximation while the fighting itself belongs to 1190. As to numbers of men, both hosts are put at about thirty thousand; the sources disagree, and most scholars take the figure from the Secret History as a rough count. As to distance and daily movement, a Mongol column covered perhaps two hundred to three hundred li a day on the grass, and since horses must drink several times a day, fighting tended to cluster at dawn, at dusk and near water. Dalan Baljud, by the meaning of its Mongolian elements, is roughly the broad plain that has a lake; its exact site has never been confirmed archaeologically and is generally placed in what is now eastern Mongolia, on the upper Onon. Casualty and prisoner figures are simply not recorded and no estimate should be made of them; what can be said is this, that after the battle Temüjin's numbers of men and horses fell sharply, while Jamuqa's confederation, receiving new deserters, began to come apart from within.
cause: 導火線是兩位安答的破裂。鐵木真與札木合早年結拜，曾經共禦大敵；後來鐵木真被諸部推為汗，而推舉本身在草原上是一種新的權威來源，它意味著部眾可以不經由泰亦赤兀氏的盟主而直屬於另一個人。札木合召集三萬人並非為了鞏固共同防線，而是要靠一場會戰把自己的號令壓過對方。深層的原因有三：其一，牧場、水源與冬牧地的分配從來靠首領之間的私約維持，而私約正隨鐵木真地位的上升而失效；其二，鐵木真帶走的人丁愈多，札木合能分給自己部眾的牲畜與俘獲就愈少，這是一種眼前可見的損耗；其三，鐵木真早年曾多次拒絕回到札木合麾下聽令，寧可獨自面對塔塔兒人與蔑兒乞人的進攻，這種不從在札木合看來即是抗命。此外，金朝對高原各部只維持鬆散的羈縻與榷場貿易，既無力仲裁，也無意仲裁，兩部一旦火併，外部勢力反而樂見其互相消耗。這場戰爭不是為爭奪某座城市或某條商道，而是要在草原上決定誰才有資格分派牧場與牧群。
causeEn: The flashpoint was the breaking of the bond between two anda. Temüjin and Jamuqa had sworn brotherhood and had once fought a common enemy; later, when Temüjin was acclaimed as khan, the acclamation itself became a new source of authority on the steppe, for it meant that the tribes could attach themselves to a different man without going through the head of the Taichiud. Jamuqa's gathering of thirty thousand was not meant to strengthen a common defence but to impose his command on his rival in one decisive engagement. Three deeper causes lie behind it. First, the division of pasture, water and winter grazing had always rested on private understandings between leaders, and those understandings were ceasing to hold as Temüjin's standing rose. Second, every man Temüjin drew away meant fewer animals and fewer captives for Jamuqa to distribute among his own people, a loss that was immediate and visible. Third, Temüjin had repeatedly refused to return under Jamuqa's orders, choosing to face the Tatars and the Merkits alone, and such disobedience could only be read as insubordination. Beyond that, the Jin court held the plateau tribes by loose supervision and frontier trade alone; it had neither the power nor the wish to arbitrate, and if two hosts collided it was content to let them wear each other down. This war was therefore fought not for a city or a trade road but to decide who had the right to allot pasture and herds.
impact: 這場敗仗的意義，恰好同它的勝負相反。鐵木真在答闌巴勒主惕輸掉了會戰，卻在戰後得到更多兵馬：他利用札木合處置俘獲、獨吞戰利品所引起的部眾不滿，成批接收原本不屬於自己的部眾與牲畜，兵力反較戰前為厚。對高原的部族政治而言，這是一種新機制，勝者可以靠對方的暴行直接取得增量，不必靠再打一場會戰。深一層看，草原的傳統是勝者為汗，這場仗卻顯示聲望與人望比一次交鋒更能決定誰來統一高原：札木合有兵力、有勝績、有財貨，卻失去服從；鐵木真有敗績、有損失，卻贏得人心。制度上的後果同樣深遠。鐵木真此後逐步以十進制的戶以及十戶、百戶、千戶的編制取代鬆散的部族聯軍，並建立怯薛宿衛，把「翼」那種臨時的軍事分隊變成常備軍隊的骨架；一二〇六年他在斡難河畔召開忽里勒台，統一蒙古高原，隨後東滅西夏、南滅金國，把這支部族聯軍推成歐亞大陸的決定性力量。技術上的歷史恰好相反：希臘火的威力依賴配方保密、銅管與帝國海軍，配方隨船沉沒便成絕響；而十三翼這種只靠人與馬維持的編組，卻能穿過敗仗活到後世。
impactEn: The meaning of this defeat runs exactly opposite to its result. Temüjin lost the field at Dalan Baljud, yet he gained men afterwards: by exploiting the resentment caused by Jamuqa's treatment of prisoners and his keeping of the spoils, he took over whole clans and their herds, and ended the campaign with a larger force than he had started with. For the tribal politics of the plateau this was a new mechanism, for a victor could draw increase directly from the other side's brutality without winning a single more battle. More deeply, the steppe had long assumed that the victor became khan, and this war showed that standing and the loyalty of men mattered more than a single engagement: Jamuqa had troops, a victory and wealth, and lost obedience; Temüjin had a defeat and a loss, and won hearts. The institutional consequences went further. In the years that followed, Temüjin gradually replaced the loose tribal confederation with a decimal organisation of household, ten, hundred and thousand, and set up the kheshig as a permanent guard, turning the improvised wing into the skeleton of a standing army. In 1206 he summoned the kurultai on the Onon, united the plateau, and then destroyed Western Xia and Jin in turn, carrying this confederation of clans into the position of the decisive force of Eurasia. The technological history of Greek fire runs the other way: its effect depended on a secret formula, bronze piping and an imperial navy, and when the formula sank with the ships it was silenced for good, while a formation maintained by nothing but men and horses could survive defeat and live on.
result: 答闌巴勒主惕的會戰以鐵木真的敗北告終，他的三萬眾被札木合的十三翼擊潰，本人在隨身數十騎的掩護下突出重圍，眾多部眾散失與被俘。札木合贏得了全部的表面戰果，戰場、俘獲、牲畜、名聲，卻在最要緊的一件事上失敗。他把所獲分給自己的將領，把鐵木真方面的俘獲者殺傷並編入己屬，此舉令旗下眾將人心離散，戰後陸續有將領率眾來投鐵木真，帶走成建制的騎隊與牧群。鐵木真由此在高原上站穩，開始以更高的組織度吸納來附者，並在往後十餘年裡逐一擊破札木合、蔑兒乞、乃蠻諸部，一二〇二年札木合再起兵而大敗，為部下所殺；一二〇六年鐵木真被尊為成吉思汗，大蒙古國成立。歷史把這場仗記在答闌巴勒主惕的名下，但它真正的結局發生在後來：蒙古高原沒有一座城被攻下，卻整片歸於一人；希臘火的祕方隨船沉沒而無人復得，十三翼的編制卻一路演成怯薛、千戶與萬戶，流傳至今仍能在蒙古人的血統記憶裡認出痕跡。
resultEn: The engagement at Dalan Baljud ended in Temüjin's defeat: his thirty thousand were broken by Jamuqa's thirteen wings, and he came out of the rout with only a few dozen riders about him while men scattered or were taken captive. Jamuqa won every visible prize of the field, the ground, the prisoners, the herds and the renown, and failed in the one thing that mattered. He divided the spoils among his own commanders and killed or absorbed the men captured from Temüjin's side, and the resentment this bred sent his commanders and their men over to Temüjin in the weeks that followed, with them whole bodies of cavalry and their herds. Temüjin was thereby established on the plateau, and over the next dozen years he picked off the Taichiud, the Merkits and the Naimans in turn: in 1202 Jamuqa raised another army, was beaten again and was killed by his own men; in 1206 Temüjin was honoured as Genghis Khan and the Mongol state was proclaimed. History files the war under the name of Dalan Baljud, but its true ending came later. No city on the plateau was taken, and the whole of it passed to one man; the formula of Greek fire sank with its ships and was never recovered, while the organisation of the thirteen wings ran on into the kheshig, the thousand-household and the ten-thousand-household, and can still be traced in the memory of the Mongol bloodline.
